title: BAMod
description: Bring Kivotos into Minecraft, and find your own miracle of youth.
body:
BAMod (Blue Archive Mod)

"Bring the daily life and miracles of Kivotos into Minecraft, and find your own youth."

> *Scroll down for the Chinese version! (向下滚动查看中文版本！)* Welcome to Kivotos! Here, every item carries a story of youth. **BAMod** is a *Blue Archive* themed mod designed for Minecraft 1.20.1 Forge. It is dedicated to bringing various items, instruments, and iconic elements—large and small—from the world of Kivotos into the blocky world. Whether you want to play a melody in your club room or collect exclusive items of your favorite students, BAMod lets you relive those touching moments in-game. > 📢 **Developer Note / Current Status:** > As BAMod is in its very early stages, the mod currently **ONLY includes "Hina's Grand Piano"**. However, this is a long-term project! I promise to continuously update the mod and gradually add more iconic items, instruments, and daily props from Kivotos in future versions. Stay tuned! ### ✨ Core Features * **🎒 Items of Kivotos**: Features a continuously updating collection of various iconic items and props from the Blue Archive universe, dedicated to recreating the daily lives and bonds of the students. *(More items coming soon!)* * **🎹 Signature Feature: Hina's Grand Piano**: * **High-Precision Model**: Based on the model created by "观星老师" (Teacher Guanxing), perfectly recreating Sorasaki Hina's exclusive piano. * **Extended 38-Key Mapping**: Maps 38 keys across the number (`1` to `=`) and letter (`QWERTY`, `ASDF`, `ZXCV`) rows of your keyboard to a wide scale from C3 to C#6. * **Professional Audio Samples**: Utilizes independent audio samples from the University of Iowa Electronic Music Studios for pure, professional sound quality. * **Immersive Playing Mode**: Automatically disables other in-game hotkeys while sitting, providing zero-latency auditory feedback that perfectly syncs with other players on the server. * **Survival Mode Friendly**: All items (including the piano) have balanced crafting recipes suitable for survival playthroughs. ### 🎼 How to Play 1. **Explore & Craft**: Use the crafting table to create various unique items from Kivotos (check recipes via JEI/REI or gallery images). 2. **Play the Piano**: Place the piano and right-click to sit down. Use your keyboard to play melodies! 3. **Dismount**: Press your "Sneak" key (usually `Left Shift`) to get up. ### ⚠️ Important Information * **Requirements**: Minecraft Forge 1.20.1. * **Multiplayer**: To ensure items work correctly and music syncs, **both the server and all clients must install this mod**. --- ### ⚖️ Rights & License Statement The core asset, the **"Hina's Grand Piano"** 3D model used in this mod, has been fully purchased (including rights for use, modification, distribution, and commercialization) by the mod author **qcrtimo** from the original creator **"观星老师"**. We hold complete legal proof of these rights. **Without explicit written authorization from the mod author qcrtimo, it is strictly prohibited for any individual or organization to:** 1. Extract, steal, or redistribute this piano model. 2. Use this model in other mods, resource packs, modpacks, or any commercial projects. We reserve the right to take legal action against any infringement. Thank you for your understanding and respect.

BAMod (蔚蓝档案模组)

"将基沃托斯的日常与奇迹带入 Minecraft，寻找属于你的青春回忆。"

欢迎来到基沃托斯！在这里，每一件物品都承载着一段青春的故事。 **BAMod** 是一款为 Minecraft 1.20.1 Forge 设计的《蔚蓝档案》主题模组。它致力于将基沃托斯中大大小小的各种物品、乐器与特色元素带入方块世界。无论你是想在社团活动室里弹奏一曲，还是收集你喜爱角色的专属物品，BAMod 都能让你在游戏中重温那份感动。 > 📢 **开发者留言 / 当前进度：** > 由于 BAMod 目前正处于起步阶段，模组内**暂时仅实装了“日奈的三角钢琴”**。但请放心！这是一个长期的工程，我承诺会在未来持续更新，将基沃托斯中更多大大小小的特色物品、乐器与日常道具逐步加入到游戏中。敬请期待！ ### ✨ 核心功能 * **🎒 基沃托斯万物**：收录了《蔚蓝档案》世界观下各种大大小小的特色物品和道具，并且内容还在持续不断更新中，致力于还原学生们的日常与羁绊。*（更多物品正在开发中！）* * **🎹 核心特色：日奈的三角钢琴**： * **高精度模型**：以“观星老师”制作的模型为基础，完美还原空崎日奈的专属钢琴。 * **扩展38键映射**：将数字键 `1` 到 `=`、以及 `QWERTY`, `ASDF`, `ZXCV` 字母区的共计 38 个按键，完美映射到 C3 至 C#6 的宽广音阶上。 * **专业级音源**：采用来自爱荷华大学电子音乐实验室的独立音源采样，确保音质专业、纯净。 * **沉浸式演奏**：当你坐下准备弹奏时，游戏内其他快捷键会被自动屏蔽；实现零延迟听觉反馈，并与服务器内其他玩家完美同步音乐。 * **生存模式适配**：所有物品（包含钢琴）均拥有平衡的合成配方，适合在生存存档中游玩。 ### 🎼 如何游玩 1. **探索与合成**：使用合成台制作来自基沃托斯的各种特色物品（具体配方请通过 JEI/REI 查看或浏览画廊图片）。 2. **钢琴演奏**：放置钢琴后，右键点击坐下。使用对应的键盘按键即可弹奏旋律！ 3. **起身**：按下你的“潜行”按键（通常为 `Left Shift`）即可脱离座位。 ### ⚠️ 关键信息 * **前置需求**：需要 Minecraft Forge 1.20.1。 * **联机须知**：为确保物品功能正常以及音乐同步，**服务器和所有客户端都必须安装此模组**。 --- ### ⚖️ 权利与许可声明 本模组中使用的核心资产 **“Hina的三角钢琴”** 3D 模型，其全部版权（包括使用、修改、分发及商业化权利）已由模组作者 **qcrtimo** 向原作者 **“观星老师”** 通过付费方式一次性买断，拥有完整的合法使用权利证明。 **未经模组作者 qcrtimo 的明确书面授权，严禁任何人或组织：** 1. 提取、盗用、或二次发布此钢琴模型。 2. 将此模型用于其他模组、资源包、整合包或任何商业项目中。 我们将保留对任何侵权行为采取法律行动的权利。感谢您的理解与尊重。
